svg.title: Copier refuses an answer the new project could not use: Copier refuses a Gherkin language it does not know, and takes its code
svg.text: Copier refuses an answer the new project could not use
Scenario: Copier refuses a Gherkin language it does not know, and takes its code

g.text: When a developer answers francais for the Gherkin language, and Copier refuses before it
The developer means French and types the word: gherkin_language=francais. Copier stops on its own message, "Validation
error for question 'gherkin_language': "francais" is not a language Gherkin knows.", and names codes it takes: en, fr,
The exit code is 1, and ls finds no acme folder: Copier wrote not a single file.

text.tspan: gherkin_language=francais /workspace acme 2>&1 | tail -n 1; echo "exit code ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; ls -d acme && grep

g.text: Then the same line with fr writes the project, and its agent rules ask for Gherkin in fr
The same line with fr, the code Gherkin gives French. Copier prints nothing, the exit code is 0, and ls finds the acme
The two AI agent rules that name the first line of a test file now ask for "# language: fr", the line a French Gherkin

text.tspan: /workspace acme 2>&1 | tail -n 1; echo "exit code ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; ls -d acme && grep -r "# language:"
